paper_title: AttentionInfluence Adopting Attention Head Influence for Weak-to-Strong   Pretraining Data Selection
caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
model_annotation: This pie chart presents the distribution of clustering results for the FineWeb-Edu Classifier, illustrating the relative proportions of different categories identified within the dataset. The chart contains twenty-eight slices, representing various categories including Policy, Manage, Emerging tech, Materials, Information technology, Science & technology education, Events & people, Society & culture, Historical review, Animal & Plant, Medical, Nutrition, Health & medicine, Diseases, and Education.  The slices are colored in shades of blue, orange, and green, with the largest slice being “Science & technology education” at approximately 19%, followed by “Education” at 17%, and “Healthy education” at 15%, with several other slices appearing to be roughly between 10% and 12%.  “Historical review” is represented by a prominent, exploded slice, colored in orange, and “Events & people” is visually emphasized, appearing offset from the other slices, while all other slices contain percentage labels within them. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their angular size.
